'''Timmy Carl Foward March''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Timmy Carl]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18775">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18775 Foward March], DeckTech (Timmy "litesaberz84" Carl, 3 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18775/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18775/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Timmy Carl]]
* '''Published:''' 3 September 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Foward March''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor FM Carl DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Kill Them All, Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition): no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' This is a basic deck with not many interrupts. I just want to get the show on the road. But what i do is build up a massive army and then attack
